description:
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Timeless Lotus.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Timeless Lotus.
Repeat.
